items.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.answer: Check-in starts at 2:00 PM, and check-out is until 12:00 PM. Early check-in or late check-out may be arranged upon availability.

items.question: Do you provide airport transfer services?
items.answer: Yes, Soliga Hotel offers private airport transfer services. Please contact our concierge for further arrangements.

items.question: Is breakfast included in the room rate?
items.answer: Yes, all room reservations include a complimentary gourmet breakfast served daily.

items.question: Are pets allowed at the hotel?
items.answer: For the comfort of all guests, pets are not permitted at Soliga Hotel.

items.question: What wellness facilities are available?
items.answer: Our wellness facilities include a luxury spa, fitness center, yoga pavilion, and personalized wellness programs.

booking.errorDate: Check-out date must be after check-in.
